title: Capture bears, ensure public safety or face protest: Udhampur Congress President

ai.summary: District Congress Committee Udhampur President Sumeet Magotra issued a 10-day ultimatum to the Wildlife Department after bear attacks injured at least five people in Panchari, Chulna area.

facts.claim: at least five persons were injured when two to three bears reportedly attacked villagers in the Chulna area at around 9:30 am on Friday
facts.quote: At least five persons were injured when two to three bears reportedly attacked villagers in the Chulna area at around 9:30 am on Friday,

facts.claim: Sumeet Magotra served a 10-day ultimatum on the Wildlife Department to take immediate and effective measures to capture the bears and ensure the safety of residents
facts.quote: Ramban, Nov 27: District Congress Committee (DCC) Udhampur President Sumeet Magotra on Friday expressed serious concern over repeated bear attacks in Chulna Panchayat of the Panchari area and served a 10-day ultimatum on the Wildlife Department to take immediate and effective measures to capture the bears and ensure the safety of residents.
